"""Hand-computed unit checks for contract-critical pieces."""
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission')
from fractions import Fraction

from offline_discovery.rule_generate import (find_high_activation_snippets, clustering,
                                             cluster_bounds, high_positions, best_window,
                                             trunc_shift, _neighbor_mask)
from offline_discovery.rule_remove import exact_entry_count, score_cluster, calibrate
from online_matching.match_p4 import PatternMatcher
from online_matching.train_rf import predict_backup, backup_features
import numpy as np

FAILS = []


def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        FAILS.append(name)
        print('FAIL', name, '\n  got ', got, '\n  want', want)
    else:
        print('ok  ', name)


# --- high activation predicate ---------------------------------------------
check('high none at equality', high_positions([0, 0, 4, 4]), [False]*4)
check('high simple', high_positions([0, 10, 10, 0, 0, 0]), [False, True, True, False, False, False])
check('high empty', high_positions([]), [])

# --- best window ------------------------------------------------------------
check('window tie earliest', best_window([1, 1, 5, 5, 1, 1], 2, 6, 2), 2)
check('window last legal', best_window([0, 0, 1, 9, 9], 0, 5, 2), 3)
check('window final tie', best_window([5, 5, 0, 5, 5], 0, 5, 2), 0)

# --- fragments --------------------------------------------------------------
rows = [{'class': 0, 'values': [10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 1514, 1514],
         'activation': [0, 0, 9, 9, 9, 9, 50]}]
# real prefix length 5; activations [0,0,9,9,9]: mean 5.4, std 4.029 -> high 9? 9>9.43 no
check('fragment padding ignored', find_high_activation_snippets(rows, 3, 4096), [])
rows = [{'class': 0, 'values': [10, 11, 12, 13, 14],
         'activation': [0, 0, 20, 20, 20]}]
# mean 12, std 9.8 -> threshold 21.8 -> none high
check('fragment threshold strict', find_high_activation_snippets(rows, 3, 4096), [])
rows = [{'class': 1, 'values': [10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16],
         'activation': [0, 0, 10, 10, 30, 30, 0]}]
# mean 12.857 std 12.66 -> thr 25.5 -> high at idx 4,5 -> run length 2 <= width 3
check('fragment run exact', find_high_activation_snippets(rows, 3, 4096),
      [(0, 4, 2, (14, 15), 1)])
rows = [{'class': 1, 'values': [10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18],
         'activation': [0, 0, 40, 41, 42, 43, 44, 0, 0]}]
# run idx2..6 length 5 > width 3 -> best window sum: [42,43,44] start 4
check('fragment long run', find_high_activation_snippets(rows, 3, 4096),
      [(0, 4, 3, (14, 15, 16), 1)])

# --- trunc / sigma ----------------------------------------------------------
# sigma = sqrt(V)/n ; V=1,n=1 -> trunc(0-1)=-1, trunc(2+1)=3
check('trunc minus exact', trunc_shift(0, 1, 1, -1), -1)
check('trunc plus exact', trunc_shift(2, 1, 1, 1), 3)
# V=2,n=1 -> sqrt2=1.41421; trunc(3-1.41421)=1 ; trunc(0-1.41421) = -1 (toward zero)
check('trunc minus irrational', trunc_shift(3, 2, 1, -1), 1)
check('trunc negative toward zero', trunc_shift(0, 2, 1, -1), -1)
# V=2,n=2 -> sigma=0.7071; trunc(1-0.7071)=0; trunc(-0.7071)=0
check('trunc scaled', trunc_shift(1, 2, 2, -1), 0)
check('trunc scaled negative', trunc_shift(0, 2, 2, -1), 0)
# V=5,n=2 -> sigma=1.118; trunc(0-1.118) = -1
check('trunc floor negative', trunc_shift(0, 5, 2, -1), -1)
check('bounds sigma int', cluster_bounds({'length': 1}, [[0], [2]]), [[0, 3]])
check('bounds clamp', cluster_bounds({'length': 1}, [[0], [3028]]), [[0, 3028]])

# --- distance / eps ---------------------------------------------------------
X = np.array([[0, 0], [2, 2]], dtype=np.int32)
check('eps equality inclusive', _neighbor_mask(X, 2, 1).tolist(), [[1, 1], [1, 1]])
check('eps just below', _neighbor_mask(X, 1999, 1000).tolist(), [[1, 0], [0, 1]])
X = np.array([[1513, 0], [1515, 0]], dtype=np.int32)
# coord0 = |1513-1515|+1000 = 1002 ; coord1 equal -> A=1
# dist = sqrt(1002^2/2)*0.6 = 425.10...
import math
d = math.sqrt(1002**2/2)*0.6
check('straddle penalty', _neighbor_mask(X, int(d*10**6), 10**6).tolist(), [[1, 1], [1, 1]])
check('straddle penalty strict', _neighbor_mask(X, int(d*10**6)-1, 10**6).tolist(), [[1, 0], [0, 1]])
X = np.array([[1514, 0], [1515, 0]], dtype=np.int32)
check('pad not straddling', _neighbor_mask(X, 1, 1).tolist(), [[1, 1], [1, 1]])

# --- clustering: cores, borders, noise --------------------------------------
frags = []
# class 0, length 2: four identical -> cores ; one near -> border ; one far -> noise
for _ in range(4):
    frags.append((0, 0, 2, (100, 100), 0))
frags.append((1, 0, 2, (101, 100), 0))       # close to the block
frags.append((2, 0, 2, (3000, 3000), 0))     # far away -> noise
clusters, noise = clustering(frags, 1, (1, 1), (0, 1))
check('cluster ids', sorted(clusters), [0])
check('cluster members', clusters[0]['members'], [0, 1, 2, 3, 4])
check('cluster core', clusters[0]['core'], [0, 1, 2, 3])
check('cluster noise', noise, [5])

# two components: border attaches to the component with the smallest core id
frags = []
for _ in range(2):
    frags.append((0, 0, 2, (100, 100), 0))    # ids 0,1
for _ in range(2):
    frags.append((0, 0, 2, (104, 100), 0))    # ids 2,3
frags.append((0, 0, 2, (102, 100), 0))        # id 4 within eps of both blocks
clusters, noise = clustering(frags, 1, (2, 1), (0, 1))
check('two components', sorted(clusters), [0, 2])
check('border to smallest id', clusters[0]['members'], [0, 1, 4])
check('second component', clusters[2]['members'], [2, 3])
check('no noise', noise, [])

# density minimum uses class total across lengths
frags = [(0, 0, 2, (100, 100), 0), (0, 0, 3, (100, 100, 100), 0),
         (0, 0, 2, (100, 100), 0)]
clusters, noise = clustering(frags, 1, (1, 1), (1, 1))
# m=3, ratio=1 -> dmin=3 ; length-2 group has 2 identical frags -> 2 neighbours < 3
check('density across lengths', (sorted(clusters), noise), ([], [0, 1, 2]))

# --- score ------------------------------------------------------------------
check('score single class', score_cluster([3], [4], 0), Fraction(30000, 1))
check('score with outside', score_cluster([2, 1], [4, 4], 0), Fraction(2, Fraction(1, 4)+Fraction(1, 10000)))
check('score zero in', score_cluster([0, 1], [4, 4], 0), Fraction(0))

# --- calibration ------------------------------------------------------------
rows = [(0, (5, 5, 5)), (0, (5, 5)), (1, (9, 9, 9))]
hits = calibrate([[[4, 6], [4, 6]]], rows, 2)
check('calibrate windows', hits, [[2, 0]])
hits = calibrate([[[0, 3028], [0, 3028]]], rows, 2)
check('calibrate wide', hits, [[2, 0]])
hits = calibrate([[[9, 9], [9, 9]]], rows, 2)
check('calibrate other class', hits, [[0, 1]])
hits = calibrate([[[0, 3028]]], rows, 2)
check('calibrate short row', hits, [[1, 1]])

# --- exact entry counting ---------------------------------------------------
b1 = [[10, 11], [20, 20]]
check('exact keys product', exact_entry_count([b1], 100), 2)
check('exact keys cap', exact_entry_count([b1], 2), 2)
check('exact keys cap clip', exact_entry_count([b1], 1), 1)
check('exact keys dedupe', exact_entry_count([b1, [tuple(p) for p in b1]], 100), 2)
check('exact keys overlap', exact_entry_count([[[10, 12], [20, 20]], [[11, 13], [20, 20]]], 100), 4)
check('exact keys pad excluded', exact_entry_count([[[1513, 1515]]], 100), 2)
check('exact keys all pad', exact_entry_count([[[1514, 1514]]], 100), 0)
check('exact keys lengths distinct', exact_entry_count([[[10, 10]], [[10, 10], [10, 10]]], 100), 2)
check('exact huge clipped', exact_entry_count([[[0, 3028]]*3], 8193), 8193)
check('exact zero cap', exact_entry_count([], 1), 0)
check('exact contained', exact_entry_count([[[10, 20], [10, 10]], [[12, 14], [10, 10]]], 100), 11)

# --- matcher ----------------------------------------------------------------
m = PatternMatcher([(7, 1, [[100, 110], [200, 210]]), (3, 0, [[105, 115]])])
check('matcher none', m.match([5]), None)
check('matcher len1', m.match([5, 106]), (3, 0, 1))
check('matcher len2 priority', m.match([106, 205]), (7, 1, 2))
check('matcher priority order', m.match([100, 106]), (3, 0, 1))
check('matcher suffix only', m.match([106, 205, 7]), None)
check('matcher empty', PatternMatcher([]).match([100, 200]), None)

# --- backup prediction ------------------------------------------------------
check('backup features pad', backup_features([1, 2], 4), [1, 2, 1514, 1514])
check('backup features cut', backup_features([1, 2, 3], 2), [1, 2])
nodes = [[0, 3428, 1, 2], [0], [1]]
check('predict left', predict_backup(nodes, [1614, 1414]), 0)
check('predict boundary', predict_backup(nodes, [1714, 0]), 0)
check('predict right', predict_backup(nodes, [1715, 0]), 1)
check('predict single leaf', predict_backup([[2]], [0, 0]), 2)

print('\nFAILURES:', FAILS if FAILS else 'none')
PYEOF
